title: Even Sets and Dual Projective Geometric Codes: A Tale of Cylinders
summary: In this paper, we prove that the smallest even sets in ${\rm PG}(n,q)$, i.e. sets that intersect every line in an even number of points, are cylinders with a hyperoval as base. This fits into a more general study of dual projective geometric codes. Let $q$ be a prime power, and define $\mathcal C_k(n,q)^\perp$ as the kernel of the $k$-space vs. point incidence matrix of ${\rm PG}(n,q)$, seen as a matrix over the prime order subfield of $\mathbb F_q$.
